title: Velvety Comforting Australian Chuck Roast
description: A sweet and comforting Australian dish featuring chuck roast, perfect for a cozy evening with friends and family. The velvety sauce is paleo-friendly and pairs well with a hot stone plate.
instructions: Season the chuck roast with salt and black pepper, then set aside.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chuck roast until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast the chuck roast at 300°F (150°C) for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
While the chuck roast is roasting, combine the brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, water, ginger, garlic, salt, and black pepper in a saucepan to make the glaze.
Bring the glaze to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the chuck roast from the oven and brush the glaze all over the top.
Return the skillet to the oven and roast for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized and sticky.
Remove the chuck roast from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the chuck roast on a hot stone plate with additional glaze spooned over the top, if desired.
